46ff1173c2de3ead.name: brainstrike_askUser
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and WAIT for their answer (the run pauses). Provide options for a structured choice (selectionMode multi_select allows several), or omit options for a free-text question

options.description:
Optional choices. Omit for a free-text question.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 10

description.description:

constraints: maximum length 1000

Optional context for the option (does not change the answer value).
constraints: maximum length 1000

label.description:
Option label; the value returned when chosen.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

question.description:
The clear, specific question to ask the user.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 2000

selectionMode.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

anyOf.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

overview.description:

risks.description:

46ff1173c2de3ead.name: brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

anyOf.description: constraints: input must match this regex ^rfh_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

anyOf.description: constraints: greater than 0
constraints: lower than or equal to 50000, greater than 0

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

anyOf.description: constraints: minimum length 1

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

46ff1173c2de3ead.name: brainstrike_writeWorkspaceFile
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Write or create a UTF-8 file in a chosen open workspace root (overwrites existing content; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). bytesWritten confirms it landed; skip re-reading

content.description:
Full UTF-8 content (up to ~2 MB); overwrites an existing file
constraints: maximum length 8000000

path.description:
Workspace-relative path; creates missing parent directories
constraints: minimum length 1

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

anyOf.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

46ff1173c2de3ead.name: brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description:
Replacement text; empty deletes the matched block
constraints: maximum length 8000000

oldStr.description:
Existing text block. Use whole lines and enough context to identify one location; ambiguous matches are refused.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 8000000

path.description:
Existing workspace-relative file path
constraints: minimum length 1

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

anyOf.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

46ff1173c2de3ead.name: agent-explore
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Delegate broad, RAG-native codebase exploration: semantic + exact search across the workspace, then read the most relevant files. Use when a question needs surveying many files before answering. Returns reported findings to verify, not established fact. Read-only leaf: cannot spawn child agents. For a hierarchy, choose an available worker-mode supervisor instead; do not assign onward delegation to this persona. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Load one or more tools into your context. Call this after finding tools with search_tools. Once loaded, tools will be available for use. Pass a single toolName or an array of toolNames to load multiple tools at once.

46ff1173c2de3ead.name: search_tools
46ff1173c2de3ead.description: Search deferred capabilities this run: canvas documents, task lists, file delete/rename, directory listings, symbol and LSP inspection, including MCP tools, by keyword. Returns at most 3 ranked matches, not a complete inventory, and does not load them: call load_tool with the exact name(s) to use a match. If you already know a tool's exact name, call load_tool directly instead of searching. For the full inventory use list_available_tools.
